disconnect_semantics: DEVICE_DISCONNECTED->DISCONNECTED, RECONNECT_STARTED->RECONNECTING at outage start; DEVICE_RECONNECTED->CONNECTED, STREAM_STARTED->STREAMING at outage end. NO record is delivered, buffered or fabricated during the outage.

illegal_transition_behavior.product_surface: A rejected transition is reported as a recoverable system.error / HTTP 409 by the product layer (CAP-003).

reconnect_clock: the source clock keeps running during an outage: sample_index and timestamp_us continue from the generator timeline and skip the outage; nothing is replayed
stop_semantics: stop_stream(): STREAMING->STOPPED (STREAM_STOPPED, reason USER_STOP); STOPPED->CONNECTED via connect() (link kept) or STOPPED->DETACHED via disconnect(); STOPPED->STREAMING is illegal; a restarted stream is a fresh deterministic stream of the same scenario
